mapper.select:
/* 댓글 데이터 조회 sry.itgcms.itgBrd.mapper.ItgBrdCmnCmntMapper.selectItgBrdCmntList 공통팀 유민상 */
SELECT A.UNITY_BBSCTT_ESNTAL_NO , A.UNITY_CMNT_SN , A.OGDP_INST_NO , A.OGDP_DEPT_CD , A.UNITY_CMNT_CN , A.ATFINO , (SELECT NVL(C.WRD_TELNO, DEC_B64(C.MBL_TELNO_ENCPT)) FROM SAA200 B, SCA100 C WHERE B.USER_ID = A.FRST_RGTR_ID AND B.ENFSN_NO = C.ENFSN_NO) AS WRD_TELNO , A.FRST_RGTR_ID , DEC_B64(SA_FN_GET_NAME(A.FRST_RGTR_ID)) AS FRST_RGTR_NM , TO_CHAR(A.FRST_REG_DT, 'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS') AS FRST_REG_DT , A.TASKWK_PRCS_SE_CD , A.TASKWK_TASKFO_SE_CD , (SELECT CMMNS_CD_VALUE_NM FROM SAC100 WHERE CMMNS_CD_ID = 'TASKWK_PRCS_SE_CD' AND CMMNS_CD_VALUE = A.TASKWK_PRCS_SE_CD) AS TASKWK_PRCS_SE_NM , (SELECT CMMNS_CD_VALUE_NM FROM SAC100 WHERE CMMNS_CD_ID = 'TASKWK_TASKFO_SE_CD' AND CMMNS_CD_VALUE = A.TASKWK_TASKFO_SE_CD) AS TASKWK_TASKFO_SE_NM FROM SBA131 A WHERE 1=1 AND NVL(A.DEL_YN, 'N') != 'Y' AND A.UNITY_BBSCTT_ESNTAL_NO = #{UNITY_BBSCTT_ESNTAL_NO} ORDER BY A.FRST_REG_DT DESC
